title: Re-enable clone_copies_memnite golden test
description: The clone_copies_memnite golden test is commented out because the script indices are wrong. The test attempts to cast Black Lotus, Memnite, activate Lotus for UUU, play Island, and cast Clone on T1. However the actual game flow doesn't match — Memnite never gets cast before Clone, and Clone enters as a 0/0 and dies. The script needs careful reworking: inspect the actual choices at each step and fix the indices. Consider using id-based selection instead of index-based to be more robust.
